items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: And he did all the publicizing of our outfit. In fact, he was the making of the outfit because we had the orchestra pictures all over the L station.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, I must have asked about that.
And he did all the publicizing of our outfit. In fact, he was the making of the outfit because we had the orchestra pictures all over the L station.
I took some pictures of that 20 years ago.
